title: 4.17 A Family Visit
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Get the house ready for a family visit: find rooms and things, follow the morning and the chores, check days, times and months, and answer nine questions out loud.
grammar_function: All German Unit 4 patterns, in a mission.
speaking_outcome: Answer questions about your home and your day out loud.

Targets: kitchen | bathroom | bedroom | living room
